{{Quote|It seems to me that mine is becoming a very important planet, Honorable Shu Mai.|Mousul|<ref name="AS" />}}
'''Mousul''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ansionian]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who represented the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="AS" />

Throughout the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|mission]] to Ansion, Mousul conspired with [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]], [[Presidente]] of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], and others to secretly compel [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] to secede from the Republic—to cause not only a chain reaction that would ultimately result in many other planets seceding from the Republic, but also to further the goals of the secessionist movement, also known as the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="AS" />
